Following playback in the Zidoo player

Nuvio recognises this box as a Zidoo and also follows the Zidoo player itself. If episodes don\'t move on to the next one after a pause, turn on \"Wait for Nuvio before playing\" below.

1. In Nuvio: Settings → Playback → Player → External.
2. In Nuvio, in the External Player section: turn on "Send intro and outro timestamps", so intros and credits can be found.
3. In Nuvio: turn on "Auto-play next episode" for Up Next.
4. Play something. When Android asks which app to use, pick Nuvio To Zidoo and choose Always.
5. On the Zidoo: Quick settings → Playback → Play mode: Single file.

Go to Up Next: after a 5 second notice the episode ends and Nuvio plays the next one. Rewind during the notice to keep watching.
How long the next episode waits before it plays, with Play now and Cancel.
Jumps to the end of a film when its credits start. Off by default: it also skips scenes after the credits.
Saves your place every 10 seconds, so stopping or switching the box off resumes there even if Nuvio lost track.
Automatic uses the current Zidoo player when the firmware has it.
Holds the start for about 15 seconds so Nuvio\'s own Zidoo tracking steps aside. Fixes episodes not moving on after a pause, at the cost of a slower start.
